videos.title: The Greater Joshua
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description: There remains a rest for the people of God, and Joshua never gave it because Jesus was always the one who would. You stop striving by trusting that He already finished what you’ve been trying to complete. Come boldly, because the throne is grace and the High Priest is yours.

videos.title: Made Like Us
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description: Religion teaches you to fear death because you might not measure up. Hebrews 2 teaches something better — Jesus killed death by dying, voided the verdict that was coming for you, and ended a lifetime of bondage in a single moment. This is the message that sets you free.
